a: Counter, Gauge, Histogram, and Summary are core Prometheus metric types.
PromQL queries time-series metrics in Prometheus.
OpenTelemetry standardizes traces, metrics, and logs instrumentation.
Jaeger is a distributed tracing system.
ELK is Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana for log search and dashboards.
Loki is a log aggregation system designed to work with Grafana.
Burn rate alerts fire when error budget is being consumed too fast.
High cardinality labels explode time series and can overload metrics systems.
Include request_id, user_id, route, status, latency_ms in logs.
Trace sampling reduces cost while keeping representative performance data.
